summary: Close the user-authorized remaining AlembicPlugin full-unit-suite gate after the real five-tool work has been accepted. Start from clean commit 6e3ba4ba6ea818075f64c535fad8b267d794a3c8. Reproduce and root-cause the nine stable failures from the controller's 2026-07-12 full run: five ProposalExecutor deprecate/snapshot assertions, three HostAgentSessionLease deepMining/session-round lifecycle assertions, and CodexSessionScenarioRunner bootstrap-missing-ai savedProjectRootWritten. Separately handle the eight 10-second failures that occur only under the 163-file parallel full suite but pass in a single-worker rerun (GuardRequestDataRootIsolation x2, HostMcpServer sequential Search, PlanDrivenGenerationGate moduleMining, ProjectGraphTool repo cap, RetrievalCheckpointDiagnostics x3). Make the smallest correct Plugin-owned code/test-harness changes so current intended behavior is tested and `npm run test:unit` passes as a whole; do not blindly raise timeouts, weaken assertions, skip tests, serialize the entire suite, or restore retired knowledge-production behavior without proving why. For every assertion mismatch, determine whether production behavior is wrong or the test encodes an obsolete contract, and record the conclusion. Preserve request-scoped project/data-root isolation, current rescan convergence semantics, no-production boundaries, and all already accepted five-tool behavior. Use only temporary fixtures; never open or mutate the live BiliDili/Workspace knowledge roots. Modify and commit AlembicPlugin only. If a failure is truly Core-owned, stop that slice and return exact ownership evidence instead of editing Core from this package. Run the affected files first, then the exact full `npm run test:unit`, `npm run check`, `npm run build`, runtime package verification, plugin distribution verification, and Codex plugin verification. Return commit, diff, raw command summaries, failure-to-fix mapping, and two-stage self-review.
sourceRef: User decision 2026-07-12: continue old failures in the same demand; controller full run 155 files passed/8 failed and 1799 tests passed/17 failed; controller single-worker rerun proved timeout-only five-tool files green and isolated 3 stable HostAgentSessionLease assertions.
designIntent: restore an honestly green full Plugin suite by reconciling obsolete assertions with current lifecycle contracts and removing suite-level contention, while preserving the already accepted real-project five-tool behavior

targetTasks.summary: Repair the nine stable AlembicPlugin unit failures and the full-suite-only concurrency/time-budget instability, then prove the entire unit suite and plugin gates green without weakening behavior.
